@[simp] lemma cons_add (x : α) (v : Fin n → α) (w : Fin n.succ → α) :
    vecCons x v + w = vecCons (x + vecHead w) (v + vecTail w) := by
  ext i; refine i.cases ?_ ?_ <;> simp [vecHead, vecTail]

@[simp]
theorem vec2_dotProduct (v w : Fin 2 → α) : v ⬝ᵥ w = v 0 * w 0 + v 1 * w 1 :=
  vec2_dotProduct'

--src: Mathlib.ModelTheory.Semantics
@[simp]
theorem realize_total : M ⊨ r.total ↔ Total fun x y : M => RelMap r ![x, y] :=
  forall_congr' fun _ =>
    forall_congr' fun _ => realize_sup.trans (or_congr realize_rel₂ realize_rel₂)

--src: Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Notation
theorem cons_vecMul_cons (x : α) (v : Fin n → α) (w : o' → α) (B : Fin n → o' → α) :
    vecCons x v ᵥ* of (vecCons w B) = x • w + v ᵥ* of B := by simp

theorem cons_val_two (x : α) (u : Fin m.succ.succ → α) : vecCons x u 2 = vecHead (vecTail u) :=

theorem vec2_dotProduct' {a₀ a₁ b₀ b₁ : α} : ![a₀, a₁] ⬝ᵥ ![b₀, b₁] = a₀ * b₀ + a₁ * b₁ := by
  rw [cons_dotProduct_cons, cons_dotProduct_cons, dotProduct_empty, add_zero]

    x • ![a₀, a₁, a₂] = ![x • a₀, x • a₁, x • a₂] := by

  rw [vec3_dotProduct, cross_apply, det_fin_three]
  norm_num
